chain.label: Pilot did not activate wing/horizontal stabilizer deice system during descent and approach despite icing-conducive weather
chain.trigger: the pilot's failure to use the wing and horizontal stabilizer deice system during the approach

chain.label: Pilot set/used non-icing landing reference speeds (Vref 92 kt) instead of the icing-required speeds (Vref 121 kt, approach 126 kt)
chain.trigger: the pilot set a Vref of 92 knots... consistent with his referencing the Normal (non-icing) checklist

caused_by.evidence: consistent with his referencing the Normal (non-icing) checklist, which does not call for the activation of the wing and horizontal stabilizer deice system

chain.label: Airplane flew in visible moisture at icing temperatures for 15+ minutes with deice off, accreting ice on wing and horizontal stabilizer
chain.trigger: the pilot was operating in an environment conducive to structural icing without either airplane ice protection system activated

caused_by.evidence: the pilot's failure to use the wing and horizontal stabilizer deice system... led to ice accumulation

chain.label: Airspeed low-speed-awareness bands and stall-warning/stick-pusher AOA thresholds remained set for the deice-off configuration, giving no valid margin indication
chain.trigger: the band indications (low speed awareness) on the airspeed display did not appropriately indicate the stall warning speed

caused_by.evidence: Because the deice system was not activated by the pilot before landing, the band indications... did not appropriately indicate the stall warning speed

chain.label: Aerodynamic stall occurred at a higher airspeed/AOA than without ice, before the aural stall warning sounded
chain.trigger: roll oscillations began and an aerodynamic stall occurred shortly before the aural stall warning... providing the pilot with no warning of the impending stall

caused_by.evidence: ice accumulation on those surfaces... resulted in an aerodynamic stall at a higher airspeed than would occur without ice accumulation
the occurrence of the stall before the aural stall warning sounded or the stick pusher activated

chain.label: Airplane entered roll oscillations after the stall, autopilot disconnected, rolling left then right up to about 154 degrees
chain.trigger: the airplane went through a series of left/right roll oscillations, eventually rolling more than 100º to the right before impact

caused_by.evidence: CVDR data showed that roll oscillations began and an aerodynamic stall occurred shortly before the aural stall warning

chain.label: Stall and loss of control occurred at only about 300 ft above field elevation, below the altitude needed for recovery
chain.trigger: Once the airplane stalled, its altitude was too low to recover

chain.label: Airplane impacted three houses and terrain in a steep left-wing-down attitude about 3/4 mile from the runway
chain.trigger: The airplane impacted three houses and terrain in a left-wing-down attitude of 110.5º about 4,000 ft from the approach end of runway 14

caused_by.evidence: roll oscillations... continued to roll to the right... impact
Once the airplane stalled, its altitude was too low to recover

chain.label: Pilot, both passengers, and three occupants of an impacted house (postcrash fire) were killed
chain.trigger: The pilot, the two passengers, and the three people in the house died as a result of the accident

caused_by.evidence: A postcrash fire involving the airplane and one of the three houses... ensued... died as a result of the accident
